mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE has been below 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production and housing starts indicates robust supply chain activity and construction sector strength, which signals a healthy economic expansion and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST have increased by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes where retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) are both above their 12-month moving averages, the S&P 500 experiences negative 20-day forward returns due to stretched valuations and profit-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST are both above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 2.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for the past 6 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and construction activity, which signals robust economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST have increased by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes where industrial production (INDPRO) has rebounded by at least 1.0% from its 6-month low, the S&P 500 experiences positive 5-day forward returns as manufacturing activity strengthens.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has rebounded by at least 1.0% from its 6-month low, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
